title: Signature Generator: Make a Handwritten Signature Online
description: Type your name, draw with a finger or photograph your signature on paper. Get a transparent PNG or SVG and sign a PDF. Free, nothing is uploaded.
promise: A free signature generator: type your name, draw with your finger or turn a photo of your paper signature into a clean image with a transparent background, then sign a PDF with it.

app.name: Signature Generator
featureList: Type a name in 14 handwriting fonts, all previewed at once
Draw with a finger, pen or mouse, with smoothing and undo
Clean a photo of a paper signature into a transparent image
Black or blue ink, thickness and slant
Transparent PNG in two sizes and a vector SVG
Place the signature on any page of a PDF
Runs in the browser, nothing is uploaded or stored

related.name: Sign PDF with form fields
related.why: Fill in a form and add text, dates and initials next to your signature.

related.name: Photos to PDF
related.why: Turn photos of a paper contract into one PDF, then sign it here.

related.name: Compress PDF
related.why: Make the signed file small enough to email or upload to a portal.

related.name: Protect PDF
related.why: Add a password before you send a signed document by email.
